title: Dill Potatoes
instructions: Cut the potatoes into halves or equal sizes. Place in cold water and set to boil.
Remove from the water and cut into quarters or bite sized pieces. Chop the fresh dill.
Mix the potatoes with enough fresh dill to coat, sprinkle more salt than you think you need, pepper, and olive oil, and a few pats of margarine if using. Mix.
Place in a pan and bake at 350 for 10-15 minutes to wilt the dill. Or return to the pot at low heat and mix occasionally until the dill is wilted.
notes: From the family cookbook. The source gives no quantities — season and scale to taste. Margarine is optional (the author likes Earth Balance). The photo on the submitted page is a family snapshot, not the dish, so the banner photo is a web photo of dill potatoes.
